Method of Attack: Masquerades as educational apps to steal Facebook account credentials including email, password, account ID, username, device name, device RAM, and device API
Opens legitimate Facebook login page inside the app using WebView and injects malicious JavaScript via 'evaluateJavascript' method to extract user inputs
Uses native libraries to hide malicious code from security software and analysis tools
Indicators of Compromise: Injected JavaScript targeting elements with ids 'm_login_email' and 'm_login_password'
Presence of 37 associated trojan apps removed from Google Play but still spread via third-party stores
Infection of at least 300,000 devices across 71 countries, primarily Vietnam
